result.quote: If we say, ‘Let us go into the city,’ we will die there from the famine in the city; but if we sit here, we will also die. So come now, let us go over to the camp of the Arameans. If they let us live, we will live
result.reason: Verse 7:4 directly supports every part of the key: entering the city or remaining at the gate meant death, while going to the Arameans offered a possibility of survival. Other formulations, such as saying they had nothing to lose, are equivalent rather than materially different answers. The edited question is natural and preserves the original question’s intended fact and answer scope.
